basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming home located in the Outer Sunset neighborhood. With 1,214 sq ft of living space, this property offers a comfortable and inviting atmosphere.  There is 2 bedrooms and 1 bath on the main level with 1 bedroom and one bath on the lower level. The kitchen provides a cozy space for meals and gatherings. The home features beautiful hardwood flooring, adding warmth and elegance to the living spaces as well as an abundance of natural light throughout. The laundry area is conveniently located in the garage, which also offers one parking space. This home is situated on a sizeable lot, providing a manageable outdoor area for your enjoyment.  This home provides a blend of comfort and functionality in one of the city's most sought-after locations.
